Context: 6. Facilities available

(xix) CGHS Pensioners and their eligible dependent family members, holding a valid CGHS card and residing in non-CGHS area are eligible to avail medical facilities (both emergency and non-emergency) for in-patient treatment and post-operative follow-up treatment subject to conditions. Similarly, CGHS beneficiaries and their eligible dependent family members (both Pensioners and serving employees) on visit to non-CGHS area are eligible to obtain treatment under emergency subject to conditions.
